integrity: The universal direction is proved symbolically for arbitrary dimension; the exact-rational computation is supplementary and replays a sharp witness.
scientific_limitations: Exact-arithmetic theorem for standard forward SOR from zero on real SPD Stieltjes matrices.
Classifies only the first two completed sweeps; no later-sweep or floating-point claim is made.
Residual originality risk remains from older monotone-iteration literature using different terminology.
title: Sharp second-sweep positivity threshold for SOR on Stieltjes systems
